source_metadata.title: Aromatase Inhibitor-Associated Musculoskeletal Syndrome: Understanding Mechanisms and Management

duplicate_consistency_findings.description: Omega-3 / SWOG S0927 is summarized differently in Table 2 (no statistically significant between-group pain-score difference) and in the prose (mean BPI-SF decreases of 2.22 vs 1.81 with p<0.001). Both source statements were retained as separate atoms rather than silently reconciled.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is optimized for primary literature and has no dedicated narrative-review claim or secondary-reported-result atom kind. Review-level syntheses use other/author_conclusion, while underlying study results use standard result kinds plus the tag secondary_reported_result.

The schema does not directly encode the cited underlying study identity inside a quantitative result; cited-study provenance is therefore preserved in canonical statements/tags and the source anchor points to the review PDF, not the original study.
extraction_limitations: This is a narrative review rather than a primary study. Quantitative study results are secondary reports and should not be treated as verified primary-study extractions.
The review does not provide a systematic search strategy, study-selection flow, or formal risk-of-bias assessment; atom extraction cannot supply those absent details.
Pure bibliography entries were excluded from atomization per ATOM guidance; they are preserved separately in the reference task queue.

The extracted atom set emphasizes independently reviewable AIMSS prevalence, risk, mechanism, clinical-feature, management, and future-direction assertions rather than every background citation about breast-cancer endocrine therapy.
